Sub: Settlement of Claims in respect of International Workers-reg.

Sir,

You are aware that as per the provisions related to International Workers, in
respect of International Workers from non SSA countries, the PF accumulations is
payable on retirement from service in the establishment after attainment of 58 years of
age and/or on retirement on account of permanent and total incapacity for work duly
certified by the Medical Officer. In this regard it has come to the notice of Head
Office that contrary to these provisions, the PF accumulations in respect of
International Workers from non SSA countries is being settled before attainment of 58
years of age.

In view of the above you are requested to get all cases of settlement of PF
claims of International Workers verified and forward a report to this office for perusal
of the CPFC.
